description: This Java source file defines the ModelFieldTypeReader class, responsible for reading and managing field type definitions in the OFBiz entity framework. It includes methods to load field type configurations from XML files, cache them, and retrieve specific ModelFieldType objects by name.

classes.name: ModelFieldTypeReader
classes.description: A class responsible for reading, caching, and retrieving field type definitions from XML configuration files within the OFBiz entity framework.

methods.name: createFieldTypeCache
methods.description: Parses XML document elements to create and return a cache mapping field type names to ModelFieldType instances.

methods.name: getModelFieldTypeReader
methods.description: Retrieves a singleton instance of ModelFieldTypeReader for a given helper name, loading configuration if necessary.

methods.name: getModelFieldType
methods.description: Returns the ModelFieldType associated with the given field type name from the cache.
